correctness.rationale: The claim is an exact finite clique-number statement. Two independent exact searches give clique number 8 on the fully reconstructed 128-vertex compatibility graph, the two encodings of the published binary 2-read vector agree for every word and pair, and an explicit eight-word witness is checked pairwise. The classical comparison is separately verified.

value.rationale: n=7 is the first nontrivial perfect binary Hamming length, making it a natural stress test of the known reduction from 2-read distance five to classical distance three. The exact value 8 versus the classical optimum 16 quantifies a genuine factor-two read-metric loss at that structural boundary, rather than an arbitrary parameter increment.
